description: Order a clinic's products for pickup at the clinic, paid online: clinic_id and product_id with quantity from search_products, and the person's name, mobile number and e-mail. A code goes to the person; confirm_with_code orders and answers with the payment link.

clinic_id.description: The clinic_id find_clinics returns. Never build it from a name. A clinic site needs none.

email.description: The person's e-mail: the order and the payment link go there.

items.description: The products, picked up at the clinic.

product_id.description: A product_id from search_products (the product slug).

name.description: The person's full name, as they say it.

note.description: A short note to the clinic in the person's words. Never health details.

payment_method.description: How the person pays on the payment link: card or Vipps.

phone.description: The person's mobile number. The code goes there by SMS.

name: order_products

code_sent_to.description: The masked phone or email the code went to.

confirmation_id.description: Pass it to confirm_with_code with the code.

status.description: code_sent: ask the person for the code, then call confirm_with_code.

title: Order products
